points.statement: An agent can complete open-ended creative building tasks via two-level autonomous embodied verification: structural speculation with visual verification and construction with pragmatic verification.
points.quote: In this section, we introduce the Luban agent, which can complete open-ended creative building tasks pragmatically in the open world with the help of the two-level autonomous embodied verification: (1) 3D structural speculation stage with the visual verification (Sec. 4.1); (2) Construction stage with the pragmatic verification (Sec. 4.2).

points.statement: A structural speculation stage uses a vision-language model to synthesize instructions into a CAD program representing building 3D objects, including decomposing, subcomponent generation, and assembling.
points.quote: The 3D structural speculation stage uses VLM to synthesize Instructions II into a CAD program representing the building 3D objects, which further includes decomposing, subcomponents generation, and assembling.

points.statement: Visual verification evaluates building quality through appearance results from constructing the CAD program.
points.quote: The visual verification evaluates the quality of buildings through the appearance results of the CAD program construction.

points.statement: A construction stage uses a vision-language model to synthesize a building's 3D object program into executable construction actions to obtain the building in the environment.
points.quote: The construction stage uses VLM to synthesize the building’s 3D object program into executable construction actions to get the building in the environment.

points.statement: Pragmatic verification evaluates a building 3D object's pragmatism by generating environment-relevant functionality annotations and action verify programs.
points.quote: The pragmatic verification evaluates the building 3D object’s pragmatism by generating environment-relevant functionality annotations and action verify programs.
